caption: The drawing features a stylized depiction of an eagle, rendered primarily in shades of gray, with the head and beak outlined in light colors and an eye accentuated in red. Draped across the eagle’s body is a long, flowing ribbon. The ribbon is bordered in red, colored blue along the central segment, and decorated with white stars. Along the ribbon, the phrase "Don't Give Up The Ship." is written in blue capital letters with white highlights, spaced out across the length of the ribbon. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, and there are no additional objects or elements present.
title: Carved Eagle
